title: Brazil's Flavio Bolsonaro wins support of third-place candidate in presidential race
summary: Brazil's right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro secured third-place finisher Augusto Cury's endorsement on Thursday, strengthening his position against incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva ahead of the runoff.
